comments.text: 3:18 I only had one meal in Taiwan that I didn't care for (lived there for almost a couple of years during a co-development project and returned at least once every year between 2008 to 2019).  It was a restaurant that served goat.  Not a goat fan, and I've never had a dish of it that I thought to order more than once.  Everything else I ate in Taiwan was great and never plain.  Note that I avoided western food restaurants like they were the plague...lol.
